d:
有小精灵（叫小精灵就有回应），有鬼（想到了鬼就会注意到），但神却不常有（因为规矩会导致利用它的人有利，不利用的没利，两极分化）
There are little elf (they respond if you call them), there are ghosts (you notice them when you think of them), but gods are rare (because the rules result in those who use them benefiting and those who don't using them gaining nothing, leading to polarization)
清醒梦：什么都可以做，你只需要一台做梦机
Lucid dream: You can do anything, you just need a dream machine
梦就像网站一样,而我们则是ai
Dreams are like websites, and we are AI
新鲜狗的灵魂容易控制,中国可能有批量制造它们
The souls of fresh dogs are easy to control; China may be mass-producing them.
灵魂可以死夺舍尸体,回去的人就不是原来的人了（间谍反了）
A soul can possess a corpse upon death, and the person who returns is no longer the same person (the spy has turned against them).
中医是道,是系统的治,西医是科技,是瞎指挥
Traditional Chinese medicine is about principles and systematic treatment; Western medicine is about technology and often involves misguided approaches
道德是正确率（模范市民），科技是瞎指挥，善、好、正、中、美意思都是不过分
Morality is accuracy (model citizen), technology is blind guidance, and the meanings of good, well, right, just, and beautiful are all properly.
执着会使心不准，不执着与不执着于不执着等等 是善也就是不过分
Attachment can make the mind inaccurate; not being attached, and not being attached to not being attached, and so on, is goodness, which means properly.
因果是善有善报恶有恶报的话，简单的看为延迟版力的作用是相互的，所以说因果是做了好事就要做坏事，那么不应该有因果，因为因果会使做错事的人做大事，但应该让正确率高的人做大事
If karma means good is rewarded with good and evil is punished with evil, then simply looking at it as a delayed version of the interaction of force, it is mutual. So if karma means doing good deeds will lead to bad deeds, then there should not be karma, because karma would make those who do wrong take on big matters, but big matters should be handled by those with a high accuracy rate.
